name: UPSC CAPF AC 2027
subtitle: Assistant Commandants: Paper I (objective) and Paper II (descriptive), one day
notes: Exam date from the UPSC calendar 2027 (notification due 17 Feb 2027). Paper I question count and negative marking follow recent papers (125 questions, one-third negative); confirm them against the 2027 notice.
Phase boundaries are a default (exam focus from 1 April); edit them to suit your plan.
Paper II is one 3-hour, 200-mark sitting; Parts A and B share the 180 minutes.

papers.name: Paper I: General Ability and Intelligence
Paper II Part A: Essay (English or Hindi)
Paper II Part B: Comprehension, précis, counter-arguments (English)

syllabus.title: Paper I: General Ability and Intelligence
General mental ability
syllabus.description: Logical reasoning, quantitative aptitude including numerical ability, and data interpretation.

syllabus.title: General science
syllabus.description: General awareness and scientific temper, including information technology, biotechnology and environmental science.

syllabus.title: Current events of national and international importance
syllabus.description: Current events in culture, arts, literature, sports, governance, societal and developmental issues, industry and trade.

syllabus.title: Indian polity and economy
syllabus.description: The Constitution, political system, public administration, economic development, and regional and international security.

syllabus.title: History of India
syllabus.description: Social, economic and political aspects of Indian history, with growth of nationalism and the freedom movement.

syllabus.title: Indian and world geography
syllabus.description: Physical, social and economic geography of India and the world.

syllabus.title: Paper II Part A: Essay
syllabus.description: Essay questions in long narrative form, in Hindi or English, totalling 80 marks.

syllabus.title: Essay themes
syllabus.description: Indicative themes: modern Indian history (especially the freedom struggle), geography, polity and economy, security and human rights, analytical ability.

syllabus.title: Paper II Part B: Comprehension and précis
syllabus.description: Comprehension, précis writing and other communication and language skills, in English only (120 marks).

syllabus.title: Précis writing
syllabus.description: Précis writing to about one third of the passage length.

syllabus.title: Arguments, reports and language skills
syllabus.description: Counter-arguments, report writing, and other communication and language skills.
